# KasGate

KasGate is an x402 v2 pay-per-call gateway on Kaspa. An agent calls a paid URL; without payment the
gateway answers HTTP 402 and a PAYMENT-REQUIRED header. The agent builds and signs one Kaspa transaction
and retries with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. A successful call returns the upstream response plus PAYMENT-RESPONSE.

The public beta runs on Kaspa testnet-10 (network kaspa:testnet-10, address prefix kaspatest:). Mainnet
is not launched. Do not send mainnet funds.

The merchant dashboard and this website are on the web host. Payment, quotes, and the machine-readable
catalog are on the gateway (API) host configured as PUBLIC_BASE_URL, typically api.<the-same-domain>.

## x402 v2 headers

All three headers are Base64(JSON) using the standard alphabet, padded.

- PAYMENT-REQUIRED: {x402Version: 2, scheme: "kaspa-exact-v1", network, asset: "KAS",
  amount (decimal sompi string), payTo, platformFee {feeTo, feeAmount}, nonce, expiresAt}.
- PAYMENT-SIGNATURE: {txId, rawTx, payerAddress, nonce, payerProof}. The signed transaction payload
  must be kasgate:v1:<nonce>. payerProof is a Schnorr signature over kasgate:v1:<nonce>:<txId>.
- PAYMENT-RESPONSE: {txId, settled: true, network, usdValueAtSettlement}.

Scheme accepted: kaspa-exact-v1. Paid path prefix on the gateway: /p/{slug} and /p/{slug}/{path}.

## Fee split and price floor

Every payment is a single non-custodial Kaspa transaction:

- output 0 is the merchant (payTo): the price minus the platform fee (98.5% once the fee is the 1.5% rate).
- output 1 is the platform treasury (feeTo): max(1.5% of the price, 0.2 KAS).
- outputs 2+ may only be change back to the buyer.

The minimum endpoint price is 0.6 KAS (60,000,000 sompi). At that price the merchant receives 0.4 KAS and
the treasury receives the 0.2 KAS floor. Funds never pass through KasGate custody.

## Prepaid credit (kasgate-prepaid-v1)

Deposit once (an ordinary payment of at least 0.6 KAS, same split), then pay calls with signed debits:
POST /v1/prepaid/deposits/quote, POST /v1/prepaid/deposits, then per call POST /v1/prepaid/challenge and
X-KasGate-Prepaid: Base64(JSON{nonce, signature}). Balance: GET /v1/prepaid/balance?slug=&payer_address=.
Unsigned, it returns only balance_sompi, spendable_sompi, expires_at and updated_at; deposited_sompi,
debited_sompi, refunded_sompi, expired_sompi and refund_hold_sompi are null. To read them, sign (depositing
key, kaspa sign_message / KasWare signMessage schnorr) the text
"KasGate\nDomain: <gateway host>\nPurpose: kasgate:v1:prepaid-balance-read\nAddress: <payer_address>\nSlug: <slug>\nTimestamp: <unix seconds>"
and send X-KasGate-Balance-Timestamp and X-KasGate-Balance-Signature (128 hex); the timestamp must be within
300 s, otherwise 401 invalid_balance_signature. The signature authorises only this read.

Refunds of unused credit: POST /v1/prepaid/refunds/challenge {slug, payer_address, action: "request",
amount_sompi?} (omit the amount for all refundable credit, at least 0.2 KAS), sign the message (Purpose
kasgate:v1:prepaid-refund) with the depositing key, POST /v1/prepaid/refunds {nonce, signature}. The merchant
pays it back on-chain to the depositing address with no platform fee (payload kasgate:v1:refund:<id hex>);
follow it with GET /v1/prepaid/refunds/status?slug=&payer_address= (public, no reasons) or a signed "status"
challenge and POST /v1/prepaid/refunds/status {nonce, signature} (with the merchant's reasons). Credit may expire if the merchant set an expiry (see
expires_at and spendable_sompi on the balance).

Failed deliveries: if a paid call's last delivery failed for good (upstream 5xx, connection error, or a timeout
unless the merchant excluded timeouts; never an oversized answer or a status below 500) and redelivery is closed
(last allowed attempt, or the redelivery window passed), the merchant share becomes prepaid credit for the payer key
at that merchant, unless the merchant had opted out when the call settled. It is capped at the prepaid balance
limit. The failing response then carries X-KasGate-Credit: Base64(JSON{creditId, kind, txId, merchantId,
creditSompi, balanceSompi, reason, shortfallSompi?}). This credit is call-only: X-KasGate-Prepaid debits spend it
first, and it is never refunded (refundable_sompi on the balance excludes it). Read your credit with POST
/v1/prepaid/credits/challenge then a signed POST /v1/prepaid/credits/status (action credits; same signing as a
refunds status challenge). Each page needs a fresh challenge. The status body takes optional before (cursor) and
limit (default 10, max 100) and returns next_cursor. Each credit has credit_id, the same ledger id as creditId
on X-KasGate-Credit. spendable_sompi and refundable_sompi on the challenge are informational only.

## Free trial calls (kasgate-trial-v1)

Some endpoints give each buyer key a few free calls. Their 402 carries X-KasGate-Trial-Offer and the catalog
lists kasgate-trial-v1. On the gateway host:

- POST /v1/trials/challenge {slug, payer_address, method, path, body_hash} (P2PK address). Sign the returned
  message (Purpose kasgate:v1:trial-call, no amount) with that key and send X-KasGate-Trial:
  Base64(JSON{nonce, signature}) on the call. The response carries X-KasGate-Trial-Remaining and
  X-KasGate-Trial-Receipt.
- When the trial is used up the gateway answers 402 trial_exhausted with its normal PAYMENT-REQUIRED: pay it.
  Trial calls move no coins and carry no fee; an upstream 5xx or no response gives the trial call back.
- Remaining calls: GET /v1/trials/status?slug=&payer_address=.

## Merchant webhooks

Merchants can register HTTPS webhooks for payment.settled, prepaid.deposit, prepaid.debit, trial.used,
endpoint.created, endpoint.updated, prepaid.refund.requested, prepaid.refund.paid, prepaid.refund.rejected,
prepaid.refund.cancelled, prepaid.refund.payout_reverted, prepaid.credit.expired, prepaid.credit.failed_delivery and prepaid.credit.failed_delivery_shortfall. Each delivery is signed: X-KasGate-Signature: t=<unix>,v1=<hex
HMAC-SHA256(secret, "<t>.<raw body>")>; reject timestamps older than 5 minutes and dedupe on X-KasGate-Event-Id.

## Catalog

A public machine-readable catalog of endpoints the merchant marked listed (active merchants only), on the
gateway host:

- GET /.well-known/x402
- GET /v1/catalog

Query parameters: limit (1-200, default 50), cursor (opaque, from next_cursor), q (optional substring
filter on slug, name, or description). Responses include Cache-Control and ETag; send If-None-Match for 304.
Each item has slug, name, description, methods, price_currency, price_sompi, price_kas, price_usd_micros, price_usd, network, schemes, paid_url, and input_schema. USD prices are not live-converted in the catalog; call GET /v1/quote/{slug} or the paid URL for the locked sompi amount
(null when the merchant has not published a schema). The catalog never includes API keys, emails, upstream
URLs, or other merchant-private fields.

Inspect one listed endpoint: GET /v1/catalog/{slug}.
Quote without paying (mints a one-time nonce): GET /v1/quote/{slug}.

This file is also served as GET /llms.txt on the gateway host.

## Buyer SDK and MCP

Python SDK (kasgate-client): KasGateClient.discover(gateway_url) and KasGateSyncClient.discover fetch the
catalog (read-only, follows pagination). Payments go through KasGateClient / KasGateSyncClient, which honour
the max_price_sompi circuit breaker and never sign a challenge above that cap. Catalog entries priced above
the cap are still listed and can be filtered with DiscoverResult.payable.

MCP server (kasgate-mcp, stdio): search_catalog, inspect_endpoint, get_budget, call_with_budget, plus the
original list_directory, quote_endpoint, and call_paid_endpoint tools. call_with_budget reserves the quoted
price before signing, enforces a per-call maximum and a session spend cap (sompi), releases the reservation
on failure, and never logs buyer keys. get_budget reports spent, reserved, and remaining sompi.

Prepaid: KasGateClient.prepaid_deposit, prepaid_request and prepaid_balance; MCP prepaid_deposit,
call_prepaid_endpoint and prepaid_balance. Refunds: KasGateClient.prepaid_refund_request, prepaid_refund_cancel and
prepaid_refunds; MCP prepaid_refund_request, prepaid_refund_cancel and prepaid_refunds. Free trials: KasGateClient.request uses an offered trial before
paying (use_free_trials=True), plus trial_request and trial_status; MCP call_free_trial and trial_status, and
the paying tools try a trial first. Webhook receivers can verify signatures with
kasgate_client.verify_webhook_signature.

Protocol details: docs/CONTRACTS.md in the KasGate repository (https://github.com/kfryster420-afk/kasgate).
